limitations: Observed-state replay preserves captured geometry/visibility and zero natural image dimensions; unavailable image bytes remain unavailable. CSS layout, animation and SVG internals are not pixel replayed.
Original scripts and event handler bodies are excluded. Listener metadata is in the capture JSON; interaction behavior is not replayed.
Remote resources use inert image placeholders. Rule targets are remapped to captured node identities, so outside-instance ancestors are not required.
